sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1.Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2.This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the non bailable warrant dated 2.12.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate-III in Complaint Case No. 12 of 2019 (Rajendra Vs, Santosh and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act,
Police Station- Sindhauli, District- Shahjahanpur.

3.After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicant is ready to appear before the court below and seek his bail and that his release be Rambahodare @ Rambahore vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104853934/
1 considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs.
Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
4.Per contra, learned AGA states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant for not pressing the other prayers made in the instant application.
5.In view of the above, in case the applicant appears before the court below within ten days from today and seeks bail, his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
6.With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed off.
